purpose: Course-agnostic inventory of material Content Factory worker boundaries and mechanically validated representations. Q1 PASS means the inventory is complete against the post-Pilot #20 candidate-recovery architecture and its ownership boundaries are executable; it does not make the overall reliability qualification PASS.

architectureResetReview.trigger: Confirmation Pilot #20 candidate-recovery architecture reset under ADR-0019
architectureResetReview.decision: Mechanical slot identity, candidate ordinal/limits, lifecycle recording, acceptance/rejection, dependency freezing, exhaustion and required-coverage reconciliation are Revision-owned. Providers own semantic educational candidate content only inside those deterministic envelopes.
qualificationEvidence: docs/technical/Content Factory Q1 Contract Ownership Qualification.md

recoveryControlOwnership.mechanicalCheck: Revision derives the slot reference from the governed question-family/component target; the provider cannot choose or replace the required slot.
Revision calculates the next durable candidate ordinal from recorded worker runs and supplies the bounded maximum; the provider receives but does not author either value.
Only a candidate that passes the complete Assessment Item contract is persisted as an accepted output. Rejected candidates are durably recorded with no output reference.
Revision derives the Marking Pack slot from the already accepted Assessment Item; the provider cannot retarget the dependency.
Revision calculates the next durable Marking Pack candidate ordinal from recorded worker runs and supplies the bounded maximum; the provider receives but does not author either value.
Only a Marking Pack that passes the complete contract receives an output reference and coverage entry. Rejected candidates remain scrap and cannot satisfy coverage.
Accepted artifacts are reused from durable state. Missing persisted accepted output/coverage is an integrity error rather than permission to regenerate or overwrite accepted work.
Revision stops after the governed candidate ceiling and blocks the course explicitly; there is no third candidate and no silent omission of the required slot.

Revision reconciles active Coverage Map requirements against accepted Learn, Practice, Assessment and Marking evidence before permitting the course manifest; rejected candidates never count as coverage.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: job, source and artifact identity bindings
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Artifacts are bound to the current job/source set and canonical fingerprints are generated by Revision.
Schema and pipeline validation reject malformed identifiers, unknown sources and invalid cross references.
Structure is schema checked while educational meaning remains model-authored and subject to later assurance.
Blueprint must match the current job and exact Course Knowledge Model fingerprint.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: work-unit IDs, requirement/node/component references and output/mode compatibility
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Unknown or duplicate references, invalid component scope and missing required output modes are rejected.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: work-unit pedagogical grouping and mode selection
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: The provider may choose pedagogically useful grouping and modes inside governed constraints.
Provider identifies a bounded location; Revision resolves the final exact learner-content string and validates teaching-point coverage.
Revision assembles immutable artifact metadata from validated upstream artifacts.
Schema and teaching-point checks constrain output without replacing educational authorship.

Provider identifies practice mode, one-based activity index and allowed field; Revision resolves the exact generated practice string and validation searches actual generated string leaves rather than JSON serialization drift.
Generated activities must use supported Practice modes selected by the governed work unit.
Revision assembles immutable artifact metadata from validated upstream artifacts.
Content remains generative judgement inside schema, mode and teaching-point constraints.
Blueprint must match the current job and Board Alignment fingerprint.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: component coverage, mark totals, timings and assessment-objective weightings
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Mechanically checkable values must equal resolved Board Alignment facts.
Provider plans assessment structure while references and component scopes are fail-closed validated.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: requested family identity and component/objective references
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Worker must return exactly requested family IDs and only known components/objectives.
Family mark range cannot exceed governed component totals.
Educational assessment design is model-authored inside blueprint and component constraints.
Revision derives the required slot, next durable candidate number and bounded candidate ceiling. These values may be supplied to the provider as context but are not provider-authored.
Unknown or out-of-scope references are rejected; Revision derives artifact provenance fields.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: question/subquestion mark arithmetic and requirement coverage
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Structured assessment integrity must reconcile marks and governed requirements without weakening intended demand.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: subquestion wording presence in rendered question
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Every structured subquestion wording must appear verbatim in learner-facing question wording.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: response demand versus learner-facing command wording
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Strict deterministic demand validation runs first; one validator-directed repair may correct a linguistic contract mismatch without removing educational demand.
Original Revision-owned assessment content remains generative judgement within governed requirements.

Revision derives the required slot from the frozen accepted Assessment Item, then derives the next durable candidate number and bounded candidate ceiling. These values may be supplied to the provider as context but are not provider-authored.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: question identity, wording, version, max mark, family and provenance bindings
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Revision assembles these values from the validated assessment item, family and blueprint rather than asking the provider to reproduce them.
For structured items, Revision derives aggregate objective allocation from validated subquestion guidance; provider-authored structured aggregate arithmetic fails closed.
Guidance must reconcile with the structured assessment and allowed objectives.
Ranges must be ordered and cannot exceed the question maximum.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: marking judgement, routes and diagnostic guidance
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Educational marking content remains model-authored and later independently assured.
Overall decision is constrained to match deterministic check failures and failed checks must carry blocking/material severity.
Validation evidence is bound to the exact reviewed implementation/content version.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: finding artifact/work-unit references and resolution-state semantics
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Findings must target reviewable artifacts; no-issue/open-state combinations are schema constrained.
Blocking/material open findings require fail_hold; open minor findings prevent unconditional pass.
Fresh-context independent reviewer provides educational judgement; deterministic rules constrain disposition semantics.
Remediation may resolve only supplied open findings against the selected smallest-safe target and validated replacement artifact.

mechanicalFields.fieldClass: dependent Marking Pack replacement for assessment-item remediation
mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: Assessment-item correction carries its genuine dependent Marking Pack; unrelated artifacts are not silently replaced.
Correction is model-authored from exact findings then revalidated through the relevant artifact contract.
Package is assembled from immutable job/manifest references and duplicate artifact refs are rejected.
Packaging requires deterministic PASS, non-fail-hold independent review and both reviews bound to the same exact commit.
Contract is derived from the exported package; imported findings cannot reference artifacts outside it.

resolvedBlockers.resolution: Downstream exact-evidence validation now searches actual generated string leaves, so locator-resolved quotes and multiline strings are validated without JSON-serialization drift.

Structured Marking Packs no longer rely on provider-authored aggregate AO arithmetic; Revision derives the aggregate from validated subquestion allocations and rejects provider-authored structured aggregates.
